body: I cannot say enough great things about EZQuest drives. After years of buggy unreliable drives, I have finally found a company/Drive that is not only reliable, but fast! We recently wrapped shooting on the feature "I Melt With You", cutting on Final Cut, and using the EZQuest Studio V for all of our editorial storage. Every day we shot with at least 4 cameras on an 18 day shoot...So you can only imagine the amount of media. Using the Studio V gave me the confidence that our media was safe and secure. We couldn't have finished the film without them.

role: First Assistant Sound Editor (Moulin Rouge, X-Men, Max Payne, Tropic Thunder, The A-Team)
product_or_topic: Thunder Pro A/V Quad Interface Drive 1TB (discontinued)
body: Enclosed is the 1TB Thunder Pro drive you generously let us test for the last month. We have put the drive through some rigorous tests, asking it to play back the most demanding ProTools session we have generated to date, carrying 203 tracks, in excess of the 192 tracks ProTools allows to be voiced at a single time. Long, continuous audio tracks are the hardest thing for ProTools to play back without issue, and this session exacerbates that burden with hundreds of edits. This is a massive session, and only the most robust systems can even attempt to play it back without interruption. By reducing the voice count to 144 tracks, we could get the drive to play back all voiced tracks, sometimes playing for several minutes across complicated re-edited sections. That is no small feat, especially considering both audio and video were being forced down a single FireWire 800 cable. An FX editor in our shop and a MX editor on the film I'm currently working on have recently purchased several of these drives as a direct result of seeing the Thunder Pro's handling of this brutal session. Please accept our thanks for allowing us time to test the drive.
